question: In a certain code language, 'NOTIFY' is coded as 'TONYFI'. What is the code for ‘PATENT' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and third letters ⇒ Interchanged their positions
 
• Fourth and sixth letters ⇒ Interchanged their positions
 
• Second and fifth letters ⇒ No change

​So,

 
• 'NOTIFY' is coded as 'TONYFI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f09e5b855ec8175ef3df59883568e88db098657e0e74bb05988299efb27d6d1.png] 

Similarly,

 
• ‘PATENT' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4290e7d0628673e07583fa046c263c7894f2248943aa2b1f205a92d88eb13050.png] 

Hence, "**TAPTNE**" is the correct answer.
